items.title: Inventory data files stop updating after relog
items.body:
Hi.
I've been using this mod for 2 month. I have to say you did an amazing port.
It has to be one of the most useful mod I have.

That said, it seems like the file that stores inventories data seems to "stop writing" itself after a while.
Could be .nbt, .json, doesn't change anything.

When I say "lock itself" I mean I can open inventories, it register/updates, but only until I log back in the game. After I log back in, everything goes where it was last saved when it **was** working as intended.

I actually have no clue how to fix this, currently I have to delete the memory bank and re-open my many barrels/chests. But that's becoming a chore and I admit if it could be fixed that would be huge.

If you need any details, please, let me know.
Have a nice day.

items.title: Memory simply doesn't work.
items.body:
I don't have idea why this is happening.
For some reason, my memory just doesn't work anymore, every time i join my server again, the data resets, even though no one else has joined to move or edit the chests. I don't know why is this happening, but it literally makes the mod useless.
The only 2 things that i think could have caused it is:
-Lithematica Mod now installed in my setup
-I changed the settings some time ago to readable JSON in the mod config.

Some more info that could be useful:
- I play in a Server (a private aternos one to be specific)
- I have other mods installed, most of them of optimization and rendering (Sodium, Continuity, etc.)
- I have Lithematica installed.
- I am playing on the last version of the mod on 1.21.11
- This problem started on a random day, before this, it worked perfectly.

items.title: Vague Memory Issue.
items.body: When using Multiverse Core, particularly when traveling through worlds, the previous world's chest data would delete itself and overwrite itself with the world you travelled to. It's becoming a big issue for me, as I would have to redo my chest checking again at my base because I traveled to a world that has an overworld prefix. I use my localhost to connect to my server. The problem really is I don't know what's causing this issue of memory loss. I can't accurately replicate the issue properly but it constantly happens when I join my server.  Please help me

items.title: Optional Server install to track contents
items.body:
Would be great if we could install the mod on the server to track chests (perhaps with a range limit) without needing to open them. 

A mod called "Bluetooth Chests" achieves this, but only shows at crafting tables. This mod shows all items from nearby chests without needing to first open them and index them. 

Similar to the above is also  "Recipe Book Access API" and mods based on it. Real time access to nearby chests which adjust to changes, without having to open the chest manually for updating what's available.

items.body: im wanting to use the name system to label my chests, and it works but when i walk away a certian distance not too far maybe 50 blocks or so, and if i wait a little and come back all the names are gone and the chests are just Large Chest again. idk why this is happening

items.title: Lowering the chest label position by one block.
items.body:
Having multiple chests on top of each other makes the chest label feature confusing. It would be useful if you were able to lower the y position of the chest label by one block so it appears inside the chest instead of on top.

_Not exactly an issue. So this may be an inappropriate place for this._

items.title: Feature request: default memory bank settings
items.body:
Hi, wouldn't it be useful to add a default memory banks settings? I'm talking mainly about things like memory lifetime... or search range, etc. Right now if you want to have your set to for example 'never expires' or lower your search range you have to manually enable it on every single world you create. :(
Let me know what do you think about it! I'm playing on fabric 1.21.11
